description: #28 slice 4: the ising-latent-v1 latents of simulator seed 7. Every checkpoint the frozen file pins (tag prereg/ising-latent-v1 on b19c2df, [[latents.checkpoints]]) reads the 15 confirmatory runs of seed 7 from tp-ising-v1-confirmatory: at L = 16, 32 and 64, the slow ramp, the staircase and the null runs at eps_L 2, 4 and 6. Ten checkpoints take the primary rule, final.pt and the step-0 twin of model seeds 1-5: ramps and null runs whole, the staircase with --select tc-plus. Twelve take the ablation rule, final.pt and the twin of EMA-only seeds 11-13 and held-out seeds 21-23: ramps and null runs whole, the staircase with --select tc-only. That is the rule latents.extraction states and ews.ising._same_selection holds each table to. Each checkpoint is pinned by the sha256 the frozen file gives it and is read from the output of tp-jepa-primary-28 or tp-jepa-ablations-28. The scorer refuses a scored run that lacks any of the 22 tables, so the five seed plans are one experiment and none of them can be left out. The plan is cut by seed so that its whole output stays far under the 18 GB at which the runner stops, carry-forward included (#112). A staged simulator run stays in the output once it holds latents, which comes to 2.37 GB for these 15 runs. The latents add 78.5 million rows at about 50 bytes a row (measured on first-read-m1 and m2), so about 3.9 GB, or 4.7 GB at 60 bytes a row. The whole output is about 6.3 GB, and at most 7.1 GB. Readout takes about 26.6 T4-hours at the pilot's rates (200, 750 and 2,760 microseconds a frame at L = 16, 32 and 64), plus about 4.5 s of start-up a table, so about 27.0 T4-hours in all. That is two sessions: the first stops at 8 h 15 min, and the second, pushed with --resume, finishes in about 5.7 h, about 14 quota hours for the plan. No run is pinned to a GPU. As a T4 comes free, it takes the next extraction in plan order, which is longest first (frames times the pilot's rate at its L), so neither T4 waits while work remains and the last tables are L = 16 ones of under two minutes. A failed extraction blocks nothing else. The prereg input pins the frozen file, so the session refuses to start until tp-prereg-ising-latent holds it in the folder 20261104T102123Z-ising-latent-v1. jepa extract takes no --prereg at this commit: the scorer judges each table by the commit, checkpoint sha256 and dataset complete.json sha256 in its manifest. The wheel dataset must hold b19c2df, and commit refuses any other before the environment is built. The first push is the line below without --resume, into a folder of its own. If out/STATUS says incomplete, or the session died, wait until it has stopped and run this one line from the main checkout, which reuses every finished table and continues the unfinished ones: uv run --no-sync python notebooks/kaggle_ising_runs.py --write-kernel notebooks/plans/extract-s7.json ../.wf/kaggle/kernel-extract-s7-resume --resume; kaggle kernels push -p ../.wf/kaggle/kernel-extract-s7-resume
